dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave trailing edge curvature following a smooth spline from the posterior dorsal ridge to a rear-pointing apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a medium pixel radius at the maximum vertical morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1 ratio between the maximum pixel base width and the vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc with a large structural radius forming the primary anterior-dorsal cranial profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust beak extending from the melon; length is roughly equal to base thickness in visible pixels.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel junction where the melon convexity transitions into the horizontal rostrum line.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-teal color profile across the body surface with high-contrast isolation against a black background.
